title: File:Welch Hall UT Austin Texas 2024.jpg
desc: Robert A. Welch Hall (abbreviated WEL) is a building located on the University of Texas at Austin campus in Austin, Texas, United States. Welch Hall is home to the chemistry and biochemistry departments. The hall has classrooms, research labs and a library, totaling over 400,000 square feet.
